parts.name: Container
parts.description: landmark surface (header, nav, aside) that scopes the navigation region

parts.name: Items list
parts.description: ordered set of links, tabs, or steps; each item is the primary interactive target

parts.name: Current-item indicator
parts.description: visual treatment that marks the active location or step

parts.name: Item icon (optional)
parts.description: leading glyph paired with the item label

parts.name: Badge or count (optional)
parts.description: numeric or dot indicator attached to an item

parts.name: Separator (optional)
parts.description: divides groups or path segments (e.g., breadcrumb chevrons)

patterns.note: hover, focus, and active item changes use the shared interaction-motion timing; transitions affect indicator position, background, and color, not layout

patterns.pattern: The "Anchor" Motion — Dropdowns, Popovers, and Tooltips
patterns.note: applies when navigation surfaces use anchored dropdowns (account, app-switcher, notification, whats-new); the panel anchors to the trigger and animates from it

requirements.title: Landmark roles
requirements.body: primary navigation uses `<nav>` or `role="navigation"`; multiple navs on a page each carry a distinct `aria-label`

requirements.title: Current-page indication
requirements.body: the active item is exposed via `aria-current="page"`, `aria-current="step"`, or `aria-selected` (tabs); visual treatment alone is not sufficient

requirements.title: Keyboard navigation
requirements.body: items reachable in DOM order; tabs follow the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern (arrow keys move focus, Tab leaves the list); dropdowns expose Enter/Space to open and Escape to close

requirements.title: Skip links
requirements.body: long primary navigation precedes a "skip to main content" link so assistive-tech users can bypass it

requirements.title: Focus order
requirements.body: focus order matches visual order; orientation changes (vertical vs horizontal) preserve a single logical sequence

requirements.title: Accessible label clarity
requirements.body: item labels describe the destination, not the visual treatment; icon-only items carry `aria-label`
